title: Cloud runs regain per-tick board events and cron sweeps after the wave deletion
description: From yoh findings dd4ae59a and 22e95d4a (l6t). The wave loop was the only producer of task-started/task-completed board events for cloud runs, and cron sweeps refuse any matching selection because no dispatch shape can name a tick batch any more. Re-home both on the new path: board events from ticfac's run feed (the container's run-epic), and sweeps submitting an epic-shaped run instead of a tick batch.
acceptance_criteria: A cloud run emits task-started/task-completed per tick from the ticfac feed; a cron sweep with a matching selection starts a run instead of refusing; tests cover both
